settings.title: Shipping
settings.content:
Orders placed before 4pm dispatch from Brisbane the same afternoon.

  • Australia: 2 to 4 days. Free standard shipping over $100, free express over $200.
  • New Zealand: 2 to 4 days. Free priority express over NZ$160.

Tracked door to door on every order.
settings.content_intl:
Orders placed before 4pm dispatch from Brisbane the same afternoon.

  • Singapore: 4 to 6 days. Free standard shipping over S$250.
  • United Kingdom: 5 to 8 days. Free standard shipping over £65.
  • Europe: 6 to 9 days.

Every international order ships DDP. Duties and import taxes are calculated and paid at checkout, so nothing is owed on arrival.

settings.title: Exchanges & Returns
settings.content:
Free exchanges and returns within 44 days across Australia and New Zealand. Send it back in the satchel it arrived in, no questions asked.

Exchanges ship the day we scan your return, so a size swap does not cost you another week. Hemming does not affect your returns window.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer:
44 days to decide, starting the day it arrives. Exchanges and returns are free within Australia and New Zealand, returned in the satchel it came in.

Outside Australia and New Zealand you cover the return postage. Duties and taxes are included in every price, so nothing is owed on arrival.

settings.question: When will they arrive?
settings.answer:
This is a pre-order. The run ships in early November 2026, and pre-orders go out first, the same afternoon they are picked. You are charged at checkout, which is what reserves your size.

If the run is delayed beyond that date we write to you, and you can cancel for a full refund.
